document: Proposed evaluation annotations — PO mode handling applied
adjudication_basis: Only each scenario original input_description and its economic context. Frozen expected_pathways, expected_outcome, pathway challenge coverage, and scoring labels were not read or used for mode assignment.

mode_definitions.M2O: The described economic mechanism is primarily an exchange, matching, or coordinated value relationship across distinct organizations/actors or a cross-market service/model transfer.
mode_definitions.A2V: The described mechanism is primarily the use, configuration, conversion, or improvement of a focal organization’s own asset, operation, process, or workflow. Mention of an external customer does not automatically make it M2O if the focal operation is the center of action.
mode_definitions.MODE_NEUTRAL: The wording does not establish either a focal asset/operation or a concrete inter-organizational value relationship; no mode is inferable without adding assumptions.

api_capability.asset_context: string, max_length=1000; required non-empty when mode is A2V
api_capability.analysis: app/services/analysis.py receives investigation mode and asset_context; explicit A2V branch exists for P6.
api_capability.neutral_warning: Do not map MODE_NEUTRAL to the M2O default and call it neutral. The API has no neutral mode.
